resources.string: Looking for HomePod and AirPlay speakers on this network…
Make sure the HomePod is plugged in and set up.
The TV and the speaker must be on the same local network.
In the Home app on iPhone, go to Home Settings › Speakers & TV and allow access for Everyone on the Same Network.
Allow it so this TV can find HomePod and other AirPlay speakers on your network.
Check that the TV is connected to a network, then choose Search Again.
Choose a speaker from the list
This speaker isn’t available right now. Make sure it’s on and on the same network.
Finish the permission prompts on screen…
Sending app audio. Open the app you want to hear.
Playing a test tone. Check that the speaker makes a sound.
Couldn’t start, or sending stopped. Make sure the speaker is on and on the same network as the TV, then try again.
Android will next ask to allow audio recording and screen capture. This app captures only the sound apps play. It never uses the microphone or records the screen.
Sending app audio needs Android 10 or later. You can still play a test tone to check the speaker.
Without audio recording permission, app audio can’t be captured. This app never uses the microphone.
This TV doesn’t support capturing app audio. You can still play a test tone to check the speaker.
Some apps don’t allow their audio to be captured, so it won’t reach the speaker. AirPlay speakers play with a delay, so video sound may be out of sync with the picture.
